```lean
by
  let sum := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1)
  have h_sum : sum = ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 * i + 1
  let sum_2_i := ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 * i
  let sum_1 := ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), 1
  have h_sum_2_i : sum_2_i = 2 * ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), i
  have h_sum_1 : sum_1 = (n + 1) * 1
  rw [h_sum, h_sum_2_i, h_sum_1]
  simp only [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_id]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_inj, Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_mul]
  rw [Nat.add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add]
  simp only [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  ring
```
